data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Fadiya means 'light' or 'radiant'. It is derived from the root word 'fadhila' which means 'to purify' or 'to make bright'. This name signifies the inner light and purity that is present in all beings. The name Fadiya carries the meaning “Light, radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fadiya usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
